mu.note: Mu agent platform (micro.mu) - 118 tools: news, web search/fetch, browser, mail, markets, weather, video, files, notes, flights, transit, prayer, sms, wallet/x402

you.note: You.com web intelligence MCP: you-search / you-contents / you-answer / you-research / you-finance. Needs YOU_API_KEY env var in Minis settings.

context7.note: Up-to-date docs for any library injected into LLM context. Keyless. Tools: resolve-library-id, get-library-docs

deepwiki.note: DeepWiki: ask questions about ANY GitHub repo, gets structured answers w/ repo knowledge. Keyless.

gitmcp.note: GitMCP: generic MCP for any GitHub repo docs (fetch_documentation, search). Keyless.
